title: Kenworth T909 Series Custom Built FUPS Compliant Road Train Polished Aluminium Bullbar #72
description: Kenworth T900, T909, FUPS compliant Custom Built 5 post Road Train high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. 76mm dia pipe. Note that 88mm & 100mm dia pipe also available. All cross pipes are one piece 6mm wall high tensile pipe, no but welds. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Full length 100mm wide reinforced uprights (additional internal gussets) plus combination Indicator, Parking and Daylight Running LED lights on outer posts. Removable combination Road Train/ Over Size signs with heavy duty storage bag, Cowcatcher and 4 small uprights plus sump guard. Additional 50mm top flat bar extension fitted to the main channel and chrome plated tow plate. Heavy duty Bullbar lift assist spring. Driving light and Light Bar mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
